purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a thesis supervisor assignment for a postgraduate student.
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated with department.allocation.manage permission. A PG student (M.Tech) and a faculty member exist.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/allocations/supervisors/ with student_id, student_name, programme='M.Tech', department='CSE', supervisor_id, supervisor_name.
expected_result: Allocation record is created with HTTP 201 Created and persisted in database.

purpose: Verify a non-admin student or unauthorized user cannot record a thesis supervisor assignment.
preconditions: A standard student is authenticated without department.allocation.manage permission.
expected_result: Request is refused with HTTP 403 Forbidden and no record is created.

source_id: CFR-OAP-019 / AFR-OAP-044 - TA assignment to course and faculty
purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a TA assignment linking a PG student to both a course and a faculty member.
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated. PG student and faculty exist.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/allocations/ta/ with student_id, course_code='CS301', course_name='Operating Systems', faculty_id, faculty_name, hours_per_week=8.
expected_result: TA allocation is created with HTTP 201 Created with both course and faculty associated.

source_id: CFR-OAP-019 / AFR-OAP-044 - TA assignment to course only
purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a TA assignment linked to a course/subject only without a designated faculty member.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/allocations/ta/ with student_id, course_code='CS101', course_name='Intro to Programming', faculty_id=null, faculty_name=''.
expected_result: TA allocation is created with HTTP 201 Created associating student to course only.

source_id: CFR-OAP-019 / AFR-OAP-044 - TA assignment to faculty only
purpose: Verify Department Administrator can record a TA assignment linked to a faculty member only.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/allocations/ta/ with student_id, course_code='', course_name='Department Research Lab', faculty_id=201, faculty_name='Dr. Sharma'.
expected_result: TA allocation is created with HTTP 201 Created associating student to faculty member.

source_id: CFR-OAP-020 / AFR-OAP-045 - PG student initiates seminar request
purpose: Verify a postgraduate student can initiate a graduate seminar scheduling request with topic, abstract, and preferred date.
preconditions: PG student (Ph.D.) is authenticated with department.seminar.request permission.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/requests/ with topic, abstract, discipline='CSE', preferred_date in future.
expected_result: Request is created with HTTP 201 Created, status='AWAITING_SCHEDULING', and student details populated.

purpose: Verify an undergraduate student (B.Tech) attempting to initiate a seminar scheduling request is rejected.
expected_result: Request is rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request or 403 Forbidden stating PG scope violation.

source_id: CFR-OAP-020 / AFR-OAP-046 - Pending requests available to Department Administrator
purpose: Verify submitted graduate seminar requests in AWAITING_SCHEDULING status are listed in the Department Administrator pending queue.
preconditions: A seminar request has been submitted by a PG student and is in AWAITING_SCHEDULING status. Department Administrator is authenticated.
expected_result: Response contains HTTP 200 OK with the pending seminar request in the results list.

source_id: CFR-OAP-021 / AFR-OAP-047 - Department Administrator schedules seminar
purpose: Verify Department Administrator can schedule a pending graduate seminar request by assigning date, time, venue, and chair.
preconditions: A request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING status exists. Department Administrator is authenticated with department.seminar.schedule.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/requests/{id}/schedule/ with scheduled_date, start_time, end_time, venue, session_chair, remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to SCHEDULED, GraduateSeminar record is created with HTTP 200 OK or 201 Created.

source_id: CFR-OAP-021 / AFR-OAP-048 - Audit history log maintained on scheduling
purpose: Verify system records an audit history entry in SeminarSchedulingHistory whenever a seminar is scheduled.
preconditions: A seminar request is successfully scheduled by Department Administrator.
action_or_input: Query SeminarSchedulingHistory records for the scheduled seminar.
expected_result: Audit history record exists with action='SCHEDULED', timestamp, and administrator's ID.

source_id: CFR-OAP-022 / AFR-OAP-049 - PG students and faculty view scheduled seminars
purpose: Verify PG students and faculty members can view scheduled seminars via the public seminar calendar.
preconditions: At least one GraduateSeminar is scheduled. Authenticated student or faculty calls list endpoint.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returned with scheduled seminar list; requests still in AWAITING_SCHEDULING or REJECTED are excluded.

source_id: CFR-OAP-022 / AFR-OAP-050 - Department announcement publishing and visibility
purpose: Verify Department Administrator can publish announcements and campus members can view them.
preconditions: Department Administrator is authenticated with department.announcement.publish.
action_or_input: POST /api/department/announcements/ with title, content, target_audience='ALL', then GET /api/department/announcements/.
expected_result: Announcement created with HTTP 201 and returned in public announcement listing with HTTP 200.
